topic.title: Town Centres / Sequential Test / Retail Impact
topic.source_contract: main town centre use, centre hierarchy and boundary, need, suitable and available sites, flexibility, accessibility, sequential assessment, impact threshold, investment impact, vitality and viability, consent, occupation and monitored trading evidence

scope_guards: An identified retail need is not treated as a site allocation.
Land ownership is not justification for failing the sequential test.
An out-of-centre site is not treated as acceptable without flexible site assessment.
A submitted impact assessment is not treated as a passed impact test.
Planning permission is not treated as completed floorspace.
Completed floorspace is not treated as occupied trading.
Forecast turnover is not treated as measured town-centre impact.
No score or promotion is written without exact assessment, decision, construction, occupation and monitoring evidence.
